How we know

Mobile Bay Riders Cycling Club's Google Calendar (edited May 11, 2026 and still live Sept 18, 2026) has a weekly Thursday series 'Iron Hand Ride, 6:15 pm; A 20+, B 16-20, C 14-16mph Groups' with no end date (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

Hosted by
Mobile Bay Riders Cycling ClubClub
Cost
free
Kind of ride
Road

For visitors

The club allows one free try-out ride (a single-event waiver is required, valid seven days); after that riders are expected to join. It is mainly a road-bike club, and the club says mountain bikes will not keep the pace.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:15 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
The easiest pace the host lists is 14–16 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

First group ride? Start here →

About the Iron Hand Thursday Ride group ride

Iron Hand Thursday Ride is a road group ride in Mobile, AL. It rolls every Thursday at 6:15 pm from Iron Hand Brewing.

A standing club ride from Iron Hand Brewing in downtown Mobile. ABC groups form depending on attendance, and the C group is no-drop. The calendar says it can be spirited or casual.
